# Hydrakin
Hydrakins are a species defined by their cybernetics and their body's ability to benefit off of normally dangerous gases.
## Unique Abilities
### Thermal Regulation
- Hydrakin bodies are [color=#FFA500]constantly heating up[/color]. As a result, they may have to manually radiate the heat out of their bodies. - They can tolerate heat without any insulation, but wearing hardsuits or coats will immediatly start [color=#FFA500]heating them up to 67°C[/color]. - Leporazine and Peranol have [color=#4169E1]amplified[/color] cooling effect on their body. - However, using any type of cryo chemicals will make hydrakins [color=#FFA500]fall asleep[/color] if their body temperature is low enough to activate it. - As well, Hydrakin's thermal regulation entirely fails in critical condition as while as being dead.
### Atmospheric Adaptation
- Hydrakins are capable of breathing all gases, with carbon dioxide and water vapor being an exception. - Unique gases (Such as Plasma, Tritium, Frezon, Nitrium, Healium and etc.) have mostly [color=#4169E1]positive[/color] effect on them, described in the "Chemicals" guidebook entry.
## Diet
- Hydrakins mostly prefer raw food. - They will get [color=#FFA500]poisoned[/color] by Theobromine (Chocolate, Tea, Coffee) and Allicin (Onion, Garlic).
## Benefits - They are [color=#1e90ff]10% more resistant to blunt damage[/color]. - Unique gases often have a positive effect on Hydrakin biology.
## Drawbacks
- They take [color=#FFA500]25% more heat damage and 15% more slash damage[/color]. - Wearing glasses is [color=#FFA500]not possible[/color] due to the head anatomy.
